answer: Each identity bonds 70 credits for one hollow relay key, then signs at the summit post in a 10-minute zenith window. The summit log and the hollow relay log must carry the same key in the same window; an auditor matches both logs; a missing, late, or copied sign-in burns the bond and voids payment. First fee 31 credits; kth fake pays 31 plus 6 times k minus 1, so 1000th pays 6025 and 1000 fakes pay 3,028,000 plus 70,000 locked, no shared key or log. A rented-attendance ring fails: one operator cannot sign 1000 zenith puzzles in one window. An honest agent pays 31 once, bond returned on audit.
